features.title: Surplus Reality: How William Greaves Constructed a Stage, Sabotaged It and Mined Truth Out of the Wreckage
The Very Living End: Frank Tashlin and the American Nervous Breakdown
features.description: In the 1950s, America was facing an unprecedented national emergency: comic books were turning children into perverts, rock and roll was turning teenagers into sex maniacs, and advertising was turning everybody else into idiots. Fortunately, former Looney Tunes animator Frank Tashlin was on hand to document the collapse of Western civilization in the brightest colors Hollywood could manufacture.
